test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

R E U_T R_ _Q T R E W _ _R E _ _T

options.text: Q E V Q T X Q
Q F W Q T X Q
Q E W Q T Y R
Q F V Q T X R

solution:
Given :- R E U_T R_ _Q T R E W _ _R E _ _T 

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) Q E V Q T X Q → R E U **Q** T - R **E V** Q T - R E W **Q T** - R E **X Q** T

 
• Here, ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81d9214967d3c907158503499c1e21e86c43d15068ca5e47c06c8aba44a51b67.png] ' is repeated.

2) Q F W Q T X Q → R E U **Q** T - R **F W** Q T - R E W **Q T** - R E **X Q** T

3) Q E W Q T Y R → R E U **Q** T - R **E W **Q T R E W **Q T** R E **Y R** T

4) Q F V Q T X R → R E U **Q** T R **F V** Q T R E W **Q T **R E **X R** T

 
• Option (1) gives the pattern of :- R E U Q T - R E V Q T - R E W Q T - R E X Q T

Hence, the correct answer is **"Q E V Q T X Q".**
